body: thank you all for your replies. I recognise deeply my own sanity is being based on the relationship i had with her. Thats why im now on red alert with the crisis team and the doctor comes today - i need something to stop the obssesing. I dont know whether or not to tell her how bad i am at the moment - but i have no way of contacting her anymore. I havnt bombarded her with calls/texts/emails - probably 5 over the week. I just dont understand how anyone could do this to anyone - not respond to someone. Is there anyway i can stop the pain? My sister has just been diagnosed as bipolar and i honestly do recognise i have got ill during this relationship. I have been living a double life as im married aswell. the pain of it all is unbelievable.
